title: Model Theory and Algorithms for One-Relator Groups
summary: We study the elementary theories and algorithmic properties of one-relator groups. We give a first-order sentence characterizing Baumslag-Solitar-freeness in this class. For fixed $|m|>1$, we regularly interpret $\BS(1,m)$ as a definable subgroup in every one-relator group containing it. We uniformly, regularly and injectively interpret integer arithmetic in countable groups of cohomological dimension at most two.
